name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain=audio>_<descriptor=sfx_sample_handle_1>. Reflects data type (opaque scalar 'handle'). The _1 suffix is a domain-meaningful channel/handle index, NOT Ghidra address residue: main allocates two distinct AIL sample handles from the DIG driver -- handle_0 (0x53EE4, used by fd2_play_sfx_with_handle) and handle_1 (0x53EE8, this symbol, used by fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank). _1 != 0x53EE8 and != any hex fragment of the address.
purpose: AIL (Miles Sound System) sample handle for SFX channel 1; the opaque HSAMPLE used by the one-shot SFX-from-bank dispatcher.
logic_summary: Allocated once at startup in main (@0x25C5E) via AIL_allocate_sample_handle(data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle), gated on a non-NULL DIG install. Thereafter read-only: fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank passes it by value to AIL_stop_sample, AIL_init_sample, AIL_set_sample_address (cast to int), AIL_set_sample_loop_count, AIL_start_sample to play a one-shot sample from the FDOTHER SFX bank. Sibling channel-0 handle (data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_0) serves the parallel fd2_play_sfx_with_handle path.
datatype: void * (4-byte AIL HSAMPLE handle on the 32-bit target; Ghidra type undefined4/dword, declared void * in src to match AIL_allocate_sample_handle return)
element_semantics: Single opaque sample-handle scalar (not an array). Value is the handle returned by AIL_allocate_sample_handle; 0 means unallocated.
notes: Verified against ground truth: read_memory(0x53EE8,32)=all zeros (BSS); Ghidra data def datatype=undefined4 len=4 label matches. xrefs_to confirm exactly 1 WRITE (main @0x25C5E) + 5 READ (fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank @0x25B76/0x25BAC/0x25BC1/0x25BD3/0x25BE1). Disassembly of reader confirms 'PUSH dword ptr [0x00053ee8]' feeding the 5 AIL sample calls. No game-side write other than the startup allocation -> is_const=false (runtime-assigned handle). src comment block (main.c lines 879-899) already accurate/precise -> keep. Ghidra plate was empty (null) -> created concise plate reflecting src conclusion via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT). No logic/type/decl changes made.
